title: Endgame technique
intro: With few pieces left, small ideas decide: racing pawns against a bishop or a knight, and zugzwang, when having to move is the problem.

lessons.title: Pawns against a bishop
lessons.summary: Push where the bishop cannot reach in time.

steps.text: White's c-pawn needs two moves to queen. Black's bishop on h2 must get to the c7-h2 diagonal or to c8. Count the moves before you push.
Push the pawn. If the bishop checks or covers c7, the king protects the next step.
steps.hint: c7 first: the king on b7 guards c8.
steps.ifWrong: Push to c7: your king already guards the queening square.
steps.ifRight: The pawn queens: the bishop could not cover c8.

steps.text: Win the bishop with a check: look for a skewer of king and bishop.
steps.hint: A bishop check on the same diagonal as the black bishop.
steps.ifWrong: Check on a5: the king moves, and the bishop behind it falls.
steps.ifRight: A skewer: the king had to move, and the bishop on d8 was lost.

lessons.title: A knight against a passed pawn
lessons.summary: Knights are slow over long distances.

steps.text: A knight needs several jumps to cross the board, and it struggles most against a pawn near the edge. Black's h-pawn is two steps from queening.

steps.hint: Push the h-pawn: the knight cannot cover both h2 and h1 in time.
steps.ifRight: The knight is too slow: the pawn will queen on h1.

lessons.title: Zugzwang
lessons.summary: Sometimes the best move is to make your opponent move.

steps.text: Zugzwang means that any move makes things worse. In king and pawn endings it decides games: the kings face each other, and whoever must step aside loses ground.
Walk your king in towards the b6 pawn.
steps.hint: Go to d5, then on to c6.
steps.ifWrong: Bring the king forward to d5.
steps.ifRight: The king reaches c6 and the b6 pawn falls. Black's king could not stop it.

steps.text: Black's e4 pawn needs its king. Step forward so the black king must give way.
steps.hint: Ke3 attacks the e4 pawn. Black's king must leave d5 and the pawn falls.
steps.ifRight: Black had to move the king away, and the e-pawn was lost.
